name: EmoNeXt
authors_or_creators: Yassine El Boudouri and Amine Bouridane. Centre for Data Analytics and Cybersecurity (CDAC), University of Sharjah, UAE.
publication_venue: IEEE 25th International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP), 2023
architecture_family: CNN (ConvNeXt-based with Spatial Transformer Network and Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks)
backbone: ConvNeXt (variants: Tiny / Small / Base / Large) augmented with a Spatial Transformer Network (STN) front-end and SE attention blocks
param_count: Approximately 28M (Tiny), 50M (Small), 89M (Base), 198M (Large) — based on ConvNeXt variants with added STN/SE modules
accuracy_fer2013: 76.12% (EmoNeXt-Large) on FER2013 test set; smaller variants ~74-75%
accuracy_affectnet: [uncertain] FER2013 was the primary benchmark in the paper; AffectNet results not the headline focus
accuracy_rafdb: [uncertain] not the primary benchmark reported in the paper (FER2013 was the focus)
pretrained_weights_available: [uncertain] partial — repository contains training/inference code; pretrained weights availability should be checked on the GitHub repo
inference_fps_or_latency: [uncertain] not explicitly reported in the paper
hardware_requirements: Trained on NVIDIA GPUs; ConvNeXt-Large variant requires substantial GPU memory (>=16GB for training)
loss_function: Cross-entropy loss combined with a self-attention regularization term (encouraging attention diversity in the STN module)
training_data_used: FER2013 (primary benchmark); ConvNeXt backbones initialized from ImageNet-pretrained weights
dynamic_fer_metrics: not applicable — EmoNeXt is a static-image FER model
robustness: [uncertain] STN module is designed to handle spatial misalignment / pose variation, but no formal evaluation on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB is reported
explainability: Spatial Transformer Network produces interpretable spatial attention/transformation; attention maps can be visualized
deployment_target: server-GPU (especially Base/Large variants); Tiny variant could be deployed on edge with optimization
